keys.reference: GitHub Actions secret RAILWAY_TOKEN in ANcpLua/qyl.mcp

keys.name: Browser store credentials (Edge + Firefox AMO)
keys.note: Use as EDGE_CLIENT_ID and EDGE_API_KEY (the file also holds the AMO pair). The same values are GitHub Actions secrets in ANcpLua/save-media and ANcpLua/yt-transcript. This file and ~/.config/vitals/set-store-secrets.sh were missing on 2026-10-05, so the values now exist only in those GitHub secrets. The Edge API key expires on 2026-11-29; its renewal writes a new copy here. Do not copy into chats.

keys.name: Chrome Web Store OAuth client
keys.note: Use as CWS_CLIENT_ID and CWS_CLIENT_SECRET (installed.client_id and installed.client_secret). Google Cloud project uplifted-nuance-408417 (server), OAuth client Desktop client 2; its only secret was added on 2026-10-05 and the older one deleted. The same values are GitHub Actions secrets CWS_CLIENT_ID and CWS_CLIENT_SECRET in ANcpLua/save-media and ANcpLua/yt-transcript; after replacing this file, set both there. Do not copy into chats.

keys.name: Chrome Web Store refresh token
keys.note: Use as CWS_REFRESH_TOKEN. Scope chromewebstore, granted on 2026-10-05 by the publisher's Google account for Desktop client 2 (see Chrome Web Store OAuth client); the previous token was rejected with invalid_grant from 2026-10-04. Mint a new one through that client's consent flow; revoke at the URL. The same value is GitHub Actions secret CWS_REFRESH_TOKEN in ANcpLua/save-media and ANcpLua/yt-transcript; after replacing this file, set both there. CWS_PUBLISHER_ID exists only as a GitHub Actions secret in both repositories. Do not copy into chats.

keys.name: AMO API
keys.note: Use as AMO_JWT_ISSUER (account field) and AMO_JWT_SECRET. One key pair per Mozilla account, shared as GitHub Actions secrets AMO_JWT_ISSUER and AMO_JWT_SECRET in ANcpLua/save-media and ANcpLua/yt-transcript. The Keychain item was missing on 2026-10-05; the pair now exists only in those GitHub secrets. Never regenerate it to restore a local copy: a new pair invalidates the old one in both repositories at once. Do not copy into chats.

keys.name: Firefox AMO credentials in publishing file
keys.note: Use as AMO_JWT_ISSUER and AMO_JWT_SECRET inside store-secrets.env; the same pair as the AMO API entry. The file was missing on 2026-10-05; see the AMO API entry. Do not copy into chats.

keys.name: Gemini for Diktat Fast
keys.note: Encrypted key owned by Diktat Fast. Vitals checks presence only. Run diktat-fast check to verify authentication through Diktat without exposing the key.

keys.name: Diktat Fast local app bridge
keys.note: Private local bridge for ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and Ghostty. Run diktat-fast doctor for named setup checks. Vitals checks presence only. Do not copy this token into chats.

keys.name: React Bits Pro license (Ultimate)
keys.note: Use as REACTBITS_LICENSE_KEY for shadcn @reactbits-starter and @reactbits-pro installs. Do not copy into chats.

keys.name: Resend API key (otel.cc sending)
keys.note: Use as RESEND_API_KEY. Sending access, restricted to the domain otel.cc. Deployed copy: Railway variable RESEND_API_KEY, project leitwert, service projektaufnahme, environment production. After replacing this file, set that Railway variable from it. Do not copy into chats.

keys.name: Railway variables (leitwert / projektaufnahme)
keys.note: Variable names are declared in .railway/railway.ts of ANcpLua/leitwert-gateway; values live only on Railway. Change them through that file and railway config apply.
keys.reference: Railway project leitwert, service projektaufnahme, environment production

keys.name: qyl collector API key (qyl / qyl-collector, qyl-mcp)
keys.note: Use as QYL_OTLP_PROJECT_KEYS on the collector, a JSON object mapping project IDs to key arrays ({"default":[key]}); clients send the key as QYL_API_KEY (x-otlp-api-key). The same value is QYL_API_KEY on qyl-mcp; replacing it means updating both, collector first. Moved on 2026-10-02 from QYL_OTLP_PRIMARY_API_KEY, which no longer exists (ANcpLua/qyl#632). Variable names are declared in .railway/railway.ts of ANcpLua/qyl and ANcpLua/qyl.mcp; values live only on Railway.
keys.reference: Railway project qyl, environment production: service qyl-collector variable QYL_OTLP_PROJECT_KEYS, service qyl-mcp variable QYL_API_KEY

keys.name: GitHub self-hosted runner archcheck-runner (ANcpLua/archcheck-thesis)
keys.note: Use as: nothing; the runner service reads it itself. It lives only inside the OrbStack machine archcheck-runner, in /home/alexandernachtmann/actions-runner/.credentials and .credentials_rsaparams, written on 2026-10-07 by build/runner.sh up in ANcpLua/archcheck-thesis from a one-hour, single-use registration token (gh api repos/ANcpLua/archcheck-thesis/actions/runners/registration-token) that is piped in and never stored. Replace with build/runner.sh remove, then up; revoke at the URL. Do not copy into chats.
keys.reference: OrbStack machine archcheck-runner, /home/alexandernachtmann/actions-runner/.credentials and .credentials_rsaparams; GitHub repository ANcpLua/archcheck-thesis, Settings > Actions > Runners
